newsitem.title: USA: DuPont Photomasks to build $75 mln plant.
newsitem.headline: DuPont Photomasks to build $75 mln plant.

text.p: DuPont Photomasks Inc said Tuesday it will build a $75 million production plant in the Portland, Ore., area.

The company said the 55,000-square-foot plant will employ about 250 people when it goes on line toward the end of 1998. A specific site has not been identified, but a search will begin immediately, it said.

In a written statement, company chairman and chief executive J. Michael Hardinger said the company chose the area because the Pacific Northwest has become an international center for semiconductor production. Photomasks are key components in the production of semiconductors.
"We see a clear need to establish a production facility there," Hardinger said.
The plant will produce photomasks using the advanced technology required to fabricate extremely minute semiconductors, the company said.
The company said the plant will be its fourth in the United States and its 11th world wide.
